title: 第5章 互相吓一跳第6章 仙缘与催命符
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
这天夜里，林渊克制住了立刻穿越的冲动。
他深知“磨刀不误砍柴功”的道理。
连续两天的精神紧绷，已经让他的身体和意志都濒临极限，在这种状态下贸然穿越，无异于送死。
一夜无梦。
林渊睡了穿越以来最安稳的一觉。
再次醒来，他精神饱满，眼神清亮锐利。
他冷静地将那根剥开的电线重新缠绕在玉佩上，小心地将插头推进了墙上的插座。
刺目的光芒再次爆发。
当玉佩彻底化为那种不祥的血红色时，林渊果断拔掉了插头。
他静静地等待着。
根据上次的经验，玉佩变红后，不会立刻传送，而是会有一个大约一到两小时的“预备期”。
他没有急于行动，而是不紧不慢地去楼下餐厅，点了一份热量最高的自助早餐。
牛奶、煎蛋、培根、黄油面包。
他有条不紊地将所有食物送进胃里，为身体储备最后的能量。
这是战前最后的补给。
回到房间，他再次检查了背包里的压缩饼干和真空牛肉干。
一切准备就绪。
他穿上厚重的黑色防护服，戴上战术头盔，冰冷的面罩贴上皮肤。
左手是锋利的工兵铲，右手紧紧握着那根沉甸甸的高压电棍。
这一刻，他不再是那个为生计奔波的社畜。

他是一名即将踏入未知丛林的孤勇猎人。
时间一分一秒流逝。
终于，胸口的玉佩猛地一烫！
那股熟悉的、无法抗拒的巨大力量瞬间将他包裹。
视野扭曲，天旋地转。
再次脚踏实地时，他正站在一片山林中，正是上次离开的地点。
他刚稳住身形，还未打量四周，一阵金铁交鸣的打斗声，便夹杂着野兽的怒吼，从前方不远处传来。
林渊的神经瞬间绷紧。
他身形一矮，整个人贴着地面，悄无声息地滑入旁边的灌木丛，目光死死锁定前方。
只见一片空地上，一个身穿青色道袍的年轻修士，正被一头浑身覆盖着黑色角质层的野猪状妖兽逼得节节败退。
道袍上血污斑斑，显然经历了一场苦战。
年轻修士手中的长刀泛着微光，应该是一柄法器，可那长刀劈在妖兽身上，只迸发出一串火星，留下一道浅浅的白痕。
妖兽的物理防御力高得吓人。
修士的呼吸已经变得粗重，每一次挥刀，刀上的光芒就黯淡一分，灵力显然消耗巨大，已是强弩之末。
“吼！”
妖兽咆哮一声，猛地前冲，锋利的獠牙直直撞向修士的胸口。
修士脸色煞白，举刀格挡，却被那股巨力撞得倒飞出去，眼看就要被妖兽的下一击拱穿胸膛。
就是现在！
林渊不再犹豫。
他如一道黑色闪电，从侧面的阴影中猛地冲出，将早已开启到最大功率的五百万伏电棍，狠狠捅进了妖兽柔软的腹部！
content_en:
That night, Lin Yuan resisted the urge to travel through time immediately.
He knows very well the principle of "sharpening a knife and chopping firewood by mistake".
Two consecutive days of mental stress had brought his body and will to the limit. To cross rashly in this state would be tantamount to death.
A dreamless night.
Lin Yuan had the most peaceful sleep since time travel.
When he woke up again, he was full of energy and his eyes were clear and sharp.
He calmly re-wrapped the stripped wire around the jade pendant and carefully pushed the plug into the wall socket.
The dazzling light erupted again.
When the jade pendant completely turned into that ominous blood-red color, Lin Yuan decisively pulled the plug.
He waited quietly.
According to the last experience, after the jade pendant turns red, it will not be transmitted immediately, but there will be a "preparation period" of about one to two hours.
He did not act in a hurry, but took his time to go to the restaurant downstairs and ordered a buffet breakfast with the highest calories.
Milk, fried eggs, bacon, bread and butter.
He methodically puts all the food into his stomach to reserve the last energy for his body.
This was the last supply before the war.
Returning to the room, he checked the compressed biscuits and vacuum beef jerky in his backpack again.
Everything is ready.
He put on thick black protective clothing and a tactical helmet, with a cold mask attached to his skin.
The left hand is a sharp engineer shovel, and the right hand holds the heavy high-voltage electric baton tightly.
At this moment, he was no longer the social creature running for a living.
He is a lone hunter who is about to enter the unknown jungle.
Time passes minute by minute.
Finally, the jade pendant on my chest suddenly became hot!
The familiar, irresistible and huge force enveloped him instantly.
The vision is distorted and the world is spinning.
When he came down to earth again, he was standing in a mountain forest, exactly where he left last time.
As soon as he stabilized his body, before he looked around, a sound of fighting, mixed with the roar of wild beasts, came from not far ahead.
Lin Yuan's nerves tensed instantly.
He dwarfed himself, his whole body pressed against the ground, and slid silently into the bushes nearby, his gaze firmly fixed on the front.
In an open space, a young monk wearing a blue robe was being forced to retreat by a wild boar-like monster covered with black cuticles.
The Taoist robe was stained with blood, obviously he had gone through a hard battle.
The long knife in the young monk's hand shimmered, and it should be a magic weapon. But when the long knife struck the monster, it only burst out a string of sparks, leaving a shallow white mark.
The monster's physical defense is frighteningly high.
The monk's breathing had become heavy. Every time he swung the sword, the light on the sword dimmed. It was obvious that his spiritual power had been consumed a lot and he was at the end of his strength.
"Roar!"
The monster roared and rushed forward, its sharp fangs hitting the monk's chest.
The monk turned pale and raised his sword to block, but was knocked backwards by the huge force. He was about to be pierced through the chest by the monster's next blow.
That's it now!
Lin Yuan no longer hesitated.
Like a bolt of black lightning, he rushed out from the shadow on the side, and stabbed the five-million-volt electric baton that had already been turned on to its maximum power into the monster's soft belly!
